title: ChangeRequest
description: A formal request to amend an active ImplementationContract. Maximum 3 CRs per contract (enforced at schema level via implementation-contract.schema.json maxItems:3 and at runtime by change-request-handler). CR ID format: CR-{first-8-hex-of-contract_id}-{3-digit-seq}.

cr_id.description: Unique CR identifier. Format: CR-{first-8-hex-chars-of-contract_id}-{NNN} where NNN is zero-padded sequence (001, 002, 003). Example: CR-a3f92c11-001. Generated by change-request-handler on submission.

contract_id.description: The contract_id (UUID v4) of the frozen ImplementationContract this CR targets.

submitted_by.description: Agent ID or human identifier. E.g. 'code-generator', 'hitl:user-123'. Not a free-text field — must match an agent or user ID in the pipeline registry.

status.description: CR lifecycle state machine. Transitions: pending → under_review → approved | rejected. Also: pending → withdrawn (submitter recalls CR). approved → (applied to contract by change-request-handler).

affected_sections.description: Section IDs from the target contract that this CR modifies. Must be a subset of contract.sections keys. Orchestrator pauses implementation streams for these sections while CR is under review.

reason.description: Why this change is necessary. Must be substantive — not an opinion. Reference concrete observations.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence strings: error messages, metric readings, requirement change references, test failure IDs. Minimum 1 evidence item required.

diff_description.description: Human-readable description of what changes in the affected sections. Does not need to be a diff format — prose describing the change is sufficient.

new_content_hints.description: Optional: section_key → brief description of new content for that section. Used by planner during amendment.

scope.description: local = affects only specified sections; cross_section = affects sections beyond affected_sections; contract_wide = requires full re-plan.

risk_level.description: Overall risk of applying this change.

streams_paused.description: Implementation task IDs that must pause while this CR is processed. Must be the minimal set — unaffected streams continue.

cascading_sections.description: Section IDs not in affected_sections that may be indirectly impacted. For awareness only — not automatically paused.

estimated_revision_time_minutes.description: Estimated time in minutes to implement this change.

rollback_possible.description: Whether this change can be rolled back if the new contract version is subsequently rejected.

reviewer_assignments.description: Auto-assigned by change-request-handler based on affected section content tags. Only relevant reviewers are dispatched.

resolved_by.description: Agent or human who resolved the CR.

resolution_notes.description: Explanation of why the CR was approved or rejected.

new_contract_version.description: Set when approved and applied — the new contract.version number after amendment.

new_contract_id.description: The contract_id of the new contract version issued after this CR was approved.

review_findings.description: ReviewFinding items produced during CR targeted review. Populated by change-request-handler after reviewer dispatch.
